title: Q-RES-ashby-journal-J4: A search that ignores how far out the variable is (measured 0.0, target >= 0.25)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: ashby-journal finding J4 is not-met (measured 0.0)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe ashby-journal:J4
**Prediction:** second_loop_kept_share >= 0.25 within 720 h
**Out of scope:** editing the study, its target or the paper to match the code; the measurement is changed only by changing the mechanism
**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation research --probe ashby-journal:J4`
**Status:** closed

Concern: A search that ignores how far out the variable is. The study: Ashby: an essential variable may inject noise proportional to its deviation (p. 3410), and specialised essential variables gain from using noise (p. 3383). A search that draws uniformly treats a near miss like a collapse.

Mechanisms that should answer it: ASHBY-ARCHIVE-1 (foundation/ultrastability.py).

Metric: share of second-order steps that brought the variable back inside its limits and were kept, target >= 0.25. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-27T17:23:13Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
